## Header 1

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(snakecase)
```
## Importing new data

```{r}
here("data-raw/nurses-stress/stress/5c/5c_1586886626/HR.csv.gz") %>%
  read_csv(
    show_col_types = FALSE, # fjerner boks med information
    name_repair = to_snake_case, # convert til snaketekst med__
    n_max = 100 # maks antal numbers
  )
```

## exercise, reading other files
```{r}
here("data-raw/nurses-stress/stress/5c/5C_1586886712/HR.csv.gz") |>
  read_csv(

    name_repair = to_snake_case,
    n_max = 100

```
